s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal viral and rheumatologic panels
normal chest radiograph and high-resolution chest CT scan
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
atypical lymphocytes with CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

differentials: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
per_call: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples, atypical lymphocytes with CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules on trunk and extremities, preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs, mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions and systemic symptoms, granulomatous inflammation possible

shortlist.label: Sweet syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules, neutrophilic dermatosis possible, systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: The presence of clonal rearrangements in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples, along with atypical lymphocytes and a nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, supports the diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Lymphomatoid papulosis typically presents with more transient and self-resolving lesions, which is not consistent with the patient's chronic symptoms and lack of response to previous treatments.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Dermatomyositis is characterized by muscle weakness and specific skin findings such as Gottron's papules, which are not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Sarcoidosis typically presents with lymphadenopathy and granulomatous inflammation on biopsy, which is not seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Sweet syndrome
rejected.why: Sweet syndrome is characterized by acute onset of fever, leukocytosis, and tender erythematous skin lesions, which is not consistent with the patient's presentation and laboratory results.
